dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Great heroes may be going a little too far...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yeah, {NICKNAME} and Paimon are used to this already!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Although they were able to catch us off guard, it's good that nothing serious happened!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that Elchingen has been arrested, what are you and the other staff gonna do...?

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: *sigh* The organizing team has been disbanded and everyone is being investigated. The good news is that most of us are just ordinary employees and didn't get involved with Elchingen's crimes...

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: I was questioned by the Corps of Thirty just before you guys pulled through. I still have to head to the Citadel of Regzar to assist them in their investigation after I deal with the mess over here...

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: How could I have been so blind and allowed Elchingen to play me like a fiddle! I honestly thought he was a good person... Dang it!

choices.text: He's in the hands of the law now.

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: You know, even if the person behind it all had ill intentions to begin with, the competition itself still holds an incredible purpose! Don't let such a great opportunity be ruined because of a few bad apples!

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: Let me know if you guys are ever in the mood to organize another Beast Tamers Tournament. I'll be sure to give it all I've got to make it something great!

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: But if you're too busy and don't mind letting me take care of it, I'll be more than happy to continue organizing the Tournament!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds great! Mr. Balfour, you truly are one of the most responsible people Paimon has ever met!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hopefully everything will go smoothly, and the Wisdom Orb modifications will live up to everyone's expectations!

choices.text: Don't be so hard on yourself.
